nv-clark-2026-dc11-albertson-anna.name: Anna Albertson
nv-clark-2026-dc11-albertson-anna.bio: Attorney and business owner who has served as a Truancy Court Judge and former teacher, per her campaign site.

nv-clark-2026-dc12-gilliam-dan.name: Dan Gilliam
nv-clark-2026-dc12-gilliam-dan.bio: Attorney and founder of The Gilliam Law Group; former Assistant City Attorney for the City of Henderson and Clark County deputy public defender.

nv-clark-2026-dc12-leavitt-michelle.name: Michelle Leavitt
nv-clark-2026-dc12-leavitt-michelle.bio: Judge on the Eighth Judicial District Court since 2002.

nv-clark-2026-dc15-hardy-joe.name: Joe Hardy, Jr.
nv-clark-2026-dc15-hardy-joe.bio: Clark County District Court Judge in Department 15, appointed in 2015; former co-managing partner of the Las Vegas office of Gordon & Rees.

nv-clark-2026-dc17-schwartz-jennifer.name: Jennifer Schwartz
nv-clark-2026-dc17-schwartz-jennifer.bio: Sitting Eighth Judicial District Court judge and graduate of the William S. Boyd School of Law at UNLV.

nv-clark-2026-dc21-clark-newberry-tara.name: Tara Clark Newberry
nv-clark-2026-dc21-clark-newberry-tara.bio: Presiding Judge of the Civil Division of the Eighth Judicial District Court; former trial attorney and mediator.

nv-clark-2026-dc21-hubert-alex.name: Alex Hubert
nv-clark-2026-dc21-hubert-alex.bio: Attorney with the Clark County Public Defender's Office since 2007, serving as a team chief and training deputy.

positions.stance: "A judge's role is to interpret the law without bias, favor, or political influence"; commits to deciding cases "based solely on facts, evidence, and the law."
Says every person in a courtroom "deserves to be treated with respect, regardless of their background, wealth, or circumstances."
"I believe in clear communication, transparency in process, and ensuring everyone understands what's happening in their case."
"The law serves people, not the other way around"; will uphold the law faithfully while remembering the people affected by each decision.

nv-clark-2026-dc25-delaney-kathleen.name: Kathleen E. Delaney
nv-clark-2026-dc25-delaney-kathleen.bio: District Court Judge in Department 25 of the Eighth Judicial District Court since 2009; practicing attorney since 1990.

nv-clark-2026-dc28-tarmu-danielle.name: Danielle A. Tarmu
nv-clark-2026-dc28-tarmu-danielle.bio: Trial lawyer for nearly 17 years focused on civil litigation.

nv-clark-2026-dc29-quagge-alex.name: Alex Quagge
nv-clark-2026-dc29-quagge-alex.bio: Prosecutor in the Clark County District Attorney's Office and former U.S. Army JAG Corps officer.

nv-clark-2026-dc30-santeramo-josh.name: Josh Santeramo
nv-clark-2026-dc30-santeramo-josh.bio: Las Vegas attorney with 15 years of courtroom litigation experience representing workers, first responders, and community members.

nv-clark-2026-dc30-wiese-jerry.name: Jerry A. Wiese, II
nv-clark-2026-dc30-wiese-jerry.bio: Eighth Judicial District Court judge in Department 30 who has served as the court's Chief Judge.

nv-clark-2026-dc31-kishner-joanna.name: Joanna S. Kishner
nv-clark-2026-dc31-kishner-joanna.bio: Judge of Department XXXI of the Eighth Judicial District Court since January 2011.
